text: The mixed 736 landing adds constructor zero initialization for mMsgFlags and mNewMsgSize. Current MboxCompactor moved to its own files and uses in-class {0} initialization. OnStartMessage separately resets mNewMsgSize and loads flags through OnRetentionQuery before stripping RuntimeOnly flags. Preserve initial object state as well as per-message reset. The next batch owns the combined backout and split relands; no failure cause is inferred from that combined backout.
title: Initialize MboxCompactor state independently from resetting each message
